label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input param flows to host variable, which is used in connectHttpByHostname(host) at line 44. Although resolveHost(host) validates the resolved IP address, the actual connection uses the original hostname string—not the validated IP. This enables SSRF via DNS rebinding, CNAME chains, or hostname-to-internal-resource mappings that bypass the IP whitelist check. Resolved sink value: host = attacker-controlled param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest').

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, then connectHttpByHostname(host) uses original hostname not validated IP
connectHttpByHostname constructs URL with host parameter directly
